synopsis: German investigators recorded an M30T that lost visual and radio contact over a flood area and crashed.
narrative: On 18 May 2024 near Wittingen, Germany, a DJI Matrice 30T operating over a flood area lost both visual and radio contact with its operator and crashed. The aircraft was destroyed and no one was hurt. The German Federal Bureau of Aircraft Accident Investigation (BFU) recorded it under reference BFU24-0402-3X.
